purpose: Preserve diagnostic conclusions that were produced during local analysis but were not present as standalone canonical JSON artifacts.

findings.observation: The volatility permission router produced the same candidate trades and returns as the v1 comparison in the inspected sample.
findings.interpretation: This run does not establish that regime routing is useless; the router did not block the trades that determined the result.
findings.next_use: Log every candidate blocked by stress and its counterfactual forward outcome before changing router thresholds.

findings.interpretation: Most losses did not first become large missed winners. Exit tuning alone is unlikely to repair the strategy; entry quality needs a different information source.
findings.next_use: Compare Price-only event labels with Price x OI x Funding event labels before testing new exits.

findings.interpretation: No-trade windows must be reported separately. They are neither wins nor losses and may not make a zero-event strategy look robust.
findings.next_use: Use the qualified-candidate Walk Forward gate and NO_STRATEGY/NO_TRADE state.

findings.interpretation: A price/volume rejection filter alone did not provide sufficient short alpha and the sample remained small.
findings.next_use: Require observed OI unwind after crowding before measuring a short event.
